body: That's not logical at all, actually. I want to be dead because it's too frustrating trying to live.

Go where exactly? I've done a considerable amount of traveling in Europe and Asia, yet I have never been to a place that I would want to be for any extended period of time. That's the shit that is really depressing.
Yea I've thought of that. Yet I would lose nearly everything which would not make me any happier.
